summary: Alien Swarm entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Alien Swarm
entries.definitive_edition: Original Valve Steam release for the 2010 campaign; Reactive Drop as separate expanded branch

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Valve Steam build with documented co-op setup

primary.version: Original Valve Steam release, with Reactive Drop documented separately
primary.why: The original Valve Steam release is the canonical 2010 Jacob's Rest route. Alien Swarm: Reactive Drop is a separate free standalone expansion/remix with more campaigns, Workshop support, bots, and up to eight-player co-op, so it should be captured as a related branch rather than silently replacing the original.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original Steam release for the 2010 campaign and record Steam build, player count, difficulty, class/loadout, input, server/peer setup, and source/mod state. If using Reactive Drop, record it as the expanded community branch with campaign and Workshop details.

secondary.exclusive_content: Expanded standalone community branch with extra campaigns, bots, PvP, Workshop, and eight-player support
secondary.what_to_play: Use for expanded/current community content after the original campaign is archived.
secondary.why: It changes the scope of the archive target and is not the untouched 2010 Valve release.

all_releases.fidelity: Canonical Valve release of the free Source co-op shooter.
all_releases.reason: primary: original route for the named game.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded standalone community release with additional modes, campaigns, bots, and Workshop content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: more complete current branch, but distinct from the original Valve release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Reactive Drop is more complete as a living branch, but the original Valve release is the fidelity target for Alien Swarm 2010.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge Reactive Drop achievements/campaigns with the original release without labeling the branch.
